refs.role: New Moravel model: fictional identity and garment consistency

prompt: Create ONE NEW photorealistic Moravel sportswear photograph, same fictional adult person and exact garment as references. Show a back view: rear three-quarter walking stride, hood down, head slightly turned into profile. Men's Hoodie in slate #4A4F57. Oversized relaxed hip-length pullover hoodie, dropped shoulders, roomy long sleeves, rib cuffs and rib hem, simple hood without drawstrings, discreet on-seam side pockets, NO central kangaroo pocket. Matte fine dense technical jersey, simple original seams. Small tonal MORAVEL left chest condensed uppercase sans, plain rear. Styling: black tapered joggers and black trainers. Entire head and shoes visible, garment unobscured. New camera placement in dark industrial gym entrance with concrete wall, hard directional sunlight, hard directional light, strong shadows and realistic anatomy. Different pose and framing from first Moravel model image. Shoes entirely plain black including soles and tongues, NO shoe marks or text. Tops blank rear, bottoms only tiny tone-on-tone MORAVEL centered rear waistband, condensed sans DIN Condensed-like. No other logos or text. Generate a new photograph, not a mirror or edit. REQUIRED CANVAS: EXACT 4:5 aspect ratio, 1122 pixels wide by 1402 pixels tall, or larger 4:5 such as 2048x2560. Compose on a wider 4:5 frame, not a tall 3:4 frame. Add horizontal scene space around the subject to achieve 4:5. No border. Keep entire shoes and hair within frame.

qa.notes: Visually inspected generation: garment silhouette, colour family, view, framing and scene; model identity and anatomy where applicable. Native dimensions independently verified at installation.
